description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform-specific operations for upgrading firmware or system images, including checking image compatibility, copying configuration, and performing upgrades on embedded Linux devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image partition layout matches the current system's layout by extracting and comparing partition tables.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the boot partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade process, including writing boot images, partition data, and UUIDs, based on the provided image.
